counter_thesis: The HOLD consensus underweights the execution hurdle embedded in BE's price: the frozen packet shows $276.98 current price versus a $45.27 DCF anchor and a 60% implied 5-year FCF CAGR, while actual and lane FCF growth estimates are unavailable. A 2.88% 10-year real yield and 8.17% one-month downward consensus price-target revisions add independent pressure if growth fails to convert into cash flow.
kill_conditions: IF within 180 days the next two quarters' FCF annualized growth is below 30% (half the packet's 60% implied 5-year FCF CAGR) THEN the current-price valuation thesis is broken.
IF within 180 days either of the next two quarterly reports shows revenue growth below 46% year over year THEN the market-implied revenue path in the frozen packet is broken.

IF within 90 days the FRED 10-year real Treasury yield remains above 2.0% (frozen reading: 2.88%) THEN the elevated discount-rate hurdle persists and the HOLD thesis that growth can validate the current multiple is broken.
